OVERVIEW OF THE GROUP’S BUSINESS Business Venture and Journey SDS Group has embarked on its business as a manufacturer and retailer of bakery products in 1984. SDS Group continues to develop varieties of new creative products to build customers’ excitement and interest in its products in the market till today. The Group strives to enrich and satisfy customers’ needs and preferences through its high-quality products at a reasonable price. It was an astonishing achievement and business journey for SDS Group as it started its home-grown business in Johor region with three subsidiary brands namely, retail brand, ‘SDS’, and wholesale brands, ‘Top Baker’ and ‘Daily’s’. Throughout the years, SDS Group has grown rapidly through business expansion of its manufacturing and distribution facilities, and retail outlets in the Food and Beverages (F&B) industry.

The Government has taken steps to cushion the immediate impact of the sudden dropped in economic activity on firms and households, preserving the country’s productive capacity by having rapid and extensive fiscal and monetary packages. In Malaysia, financial stimulus packages and PRIHATIN packages were released to support the society, providing assistance to lighten the burden of people from various backgrounds, such as students, families and business owners.
